# 1 Clement Chapter 64 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 64 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_064_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 64

*[Closing Doxology]*

**64:1** Now may the God of all things, who sees everything, who is the Ruler of all spirits and the Lord of all flesh, who chose the Lord Jesus Christ and us through him to be his own special people — may he grant to every soul that is called by his magnificent and holy name: faith, fear, peace, long-suffering, self-control, purity, and sobriety, that they may be found well-pleasing to his name through our High Priest and Champion, Jesus Christ, through whom be glory and majesty, power and honor to him, both now and for evermore and for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
